company_source.quote: Year 2027 View All News Logitech Announces Date for Release of Second Quarter Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2027 October 6, 2026 LAUSANNE, Switzerland and SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Logitech International (SIX: LOGN) (Nasdaq: LOGI) today announced that it expects to release second quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. Pacific Daylight Time (PDT) and 9:00 p.m. Central European Time (CET).
